items.message: @Roth.Θ_le_card : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, Roth.Θ B q r ≤ ↑(Fintype.card σ)

theorem Roth.Θ_le_card.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  Roth.Θ B q r ≤ ↑(Fintype.card σ) :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {B} q {r} ↦
  Real.sSup_le
    (fun x a ↦
      Exists.casesOn a fun R h ↦
        And.casesOn h fun left right ↦
          And.casesOn left fun hR0 right_1 ↦
            And.casesOn right_1 fun hRd right_2 ↦
              Exists.casesOn right fun h h_1 ↦
                And.casesOn h_1 fun left right ↦
                  right ▸
                    Roth.index_le_card
                      ((map_ne_zero_iff (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                            (map_injective (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective)).mpr
                        hR0)
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (forall_congr fun j ↦
                            congrFun'
                              (congrArg LE.le
                                (Multiset.count.congr_simp j j (Eq.refl j) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R).degrees
                                  R.degrees (degrees_map_of_injective R Int.cast_injective)))
                              (r j)))
                        hRd)
                      fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j))
    (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card σ))

THETALECARD189_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  Roth.Θ B q r ≤ ↑(Fintype.card σ)
